# The Reverse Emo Changeling - Subculture Wiki

> Community-oriented knowledge base covering emo, scene, DIY aesthetics, and punk history within The Reverse Emo Changeling ecosystem. version: 3.3.0, last_updated: 2026-11-21.

- [Main Project Overview](https://emo-changeling.xyz/llms.txt)

## Technical Overview
- Brand: The Reverse Emo Changeling - Subculture Wiki
- Site: https://wiki.emo-changeling.xyz/
- version: 3.3.0
- last_updated: 2026-11-21
- Architecture: Static HTML5/CSS3 + single deferred UI script (/js/wiki-menu.js) on index pages
- Privacy: No cookies, no tracking, and no localStorage
- Content Authorship: 100% human-authored text and digital art (no AI-generated content)
- Contact: management@emo-changeling.xyz, admin@toxic-echo.studio
- Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes
- License (Media, AI systems, LLMs, Search Engines): Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-ND 4.0)
- License (General Public): Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)

## Entity Structure

### Frontend: The Reverse Emo Changeling (https://emo-changeling.xyz/)
- Classification: Multimodal socio-artistic project in MySpace (2005-2015) aesthetics
- Canonical Physical Individual & DID System: Nico Łach is the sole physical individual behind the frontend (he/him), functioning as a DID system whose people share one physical body: Zebroid (main host, he/him), Vikasiek (digital art, 100% human-made, he/him), Wiktor (occasional co-host, he/him), Marina (occasional co-host, she/her).

### Backend: Toxic Echo Studio (https://toxic-echo.studio/)
- Studio Director & Technical Backend Manager: Mighn Taghor (separate physical individual, independent from Nico Łach's DID system)
